pages.text: The $(d)Nature Core$() structure can be found randomly around the overworld, with a Nature Chest nearby full of goodies.

The Nature Core can also do these things randomly:$(br2)$(li)Convert nearby Sand into Dirt/Grass$(br)$(li)Spawn an animal nearby$(br)$(li)Bone Meal nearby crops$(br)$(li)Plant Saplings nearby$(br)$(li)Repair the structure around it
